HOME SCIENCE MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts
